name: Party
description: A legal entity with a VAT identification number or another unique identification code (e.g. LEI, company registration number).

name: Area
description: A delimited domain, uniquely identified for a specific purpose, where energy consumption, production or trade may be determined: geographical or market areas such as control areas, balance groups, bidding zones, balancing areas.

name: Measurement point
description: A physical or logical point where energy is measured or calculated.

name: Resource object
description: An object used for production, consumption or storage of energy (e.g. generation unit, production unit, LNG terminal, gas storage); excludes passive grid elements such as lines or transformers.

name: Tie-line
description: A connecting object such as an interconnection line, line, busbar coupler or transformer.

name: Location
description: A physical or logical place where a party could be located, or an IT system operated by one or more parties; always has a responsible party.
